module: Node "Route Distance" (repeat_instant). Computes the approximate remaining distance along the navgraph between a tracked position and the end of a route. The route is defined either by two positions posA/posB, or by a list of waypoints ("Waypoints" checkbox in the inspector). Inputs: setRoute (pulse), trackedPos (vec3), posA, posB (or waypoints). Output: dist (number, -1 if invalid). Uses gameplay/route/route.
notes: The route is stored in a local variable of the file (shared by all instances of the node).
With posA/posB, the route is built in the order {posB, posA}.
The comparison trackedPos ~= lastTrackedPosValue compares tables: it is almost always true.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves the state of the Waypoints checkbox.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the Waypoints checkbox and updates the pins.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the "Waypoints" checkbox; changing it calls updatePins.

updatePins.desc: Replaces the posA/posB pins with a "waypoints" table pin (or the reverse) according to the checkbox, creating only the missing pins.

work.desc: Sets dist to -1; on setRoute, creates the route (route:setupPathMulti) from the points; tracks the position (route:trackPosition) when flow is active and trackedPos has changed; returns route.path[1].distToTarget.
